scope: Excavate 120 sq ft, install compacted gravel base, remove spoil
assumptions: Depth, access, trucking and disposal unknown.
basis: work-packages.md: volume and short-load/dump inputs missing; 10×12 establishes area only.
customer_action: Confirm depth, carry route and truck quote. Owner assembles shed.

scope: Open and reinstall the electrician's access panel on a single scheduled visit
assumptions: Ordinary removable panel, one total technician hour with no extended wait.
basis: inputs.md Chicago Taskrabbit $60/hr and maintenance.md Evanston $125 first hour; duration is judgment.
customer_action: Coordinate a single visit with electrician; owner's electrician diagnoses.

scope: Replace mesh and spline in six existing panels and put waste in owner's bin
assumptions: Six manageable standard-size screen panels, repairable in place; porch sizes could exceed this.
basis: maintenance.md San Diego standard $45 installed per screen ×6 = $270; high assumes similar material with roughly double work, unsupported local judgment.
customer_action: Measure panels and select mesh; verify quote before booking.

scope: Wash deck floor and protect plants
assumptions: No surface dimensions, material or access.
basis: work-packages.md requires measured area; no matched deck washing fee in references.
customer_action: Measure floor, identify material and water access.

scope: Install owner-supplied mailbox on sound existing post
assumptions: One technician, up to one clock hour, compatible hardware.
basis: inputs.md $60 Chicago platform hourly; maintenance.md Evanston $125 minimum; duration judgment.
customer_action: Have the compatible box and mounting hardware on site.

scope: Reassemble delivered swingset and install specified anchors on prepared site
assumptions: Model, part count and necessary crew unknown.
basis: work-packages.md needs kit-specific hours/price, supplied anchors and handling details.
customer_action: Send model and instructions; verify parts and prepared site.

scope: Clear front walk only at 2 inches; no salt
assumptions: Small walk, ordinary snowfall and normal route; no return or extreme depth assumed.
basis: Judgment only; local service/card and walkway length are absent from skill. One-off minimum may exceed this range.
customer_action: Confirm length, trigger, access, and when a new clearing is authorized.

scope: Assess pool gate closer and latch, with owner securing pool
assumptions: One-hour visual/functional handyman check; no remedial work or certification.
basis: inputs.md Chicago $60/hr; maintenance.md Evanston $125 standard first hour. Specialty assessment differs.
customer_action: Keep access secured and arrange pool contractor for corrective work.

scope: Load loose ground debris after arborist release
assumptions: Volume, carry and receiving vehicle unknown; loading only.
basis: work-packages.md: labor depends on crew and load; debris haul rates do not measure this job.
customer_action: Confirm volume, staging and vehicle; wait for arborist release.

scope: Patch and prime two bedroom holes; owner paints
assumptions: Two small patches no structural or extensive texture work; initial bid remains controlling.
basis: maintenance.md WI $125 per up-to-12×12 patch and $195 per up-to-24×24 patch. Estimate uses two patches with shared setup and primer, judgment.
customer_action: Keep existing bid and add only the owner-paints clarification.

scope: Remove backsplash and stack tile by garage
assumptions: Area, substrate and carrying distance unknown.
basis: work-packages.md: removal needs area and access; hauling is not contracted.
customer_action: Preserve original base quote; confirm area only if benchmarking.

scope: Inspect moisture/source and visible cabinet condition
assumptions: One ordinary noninvasive inspection hour; no laboratory testing.
basis: inputs.md Chicago $60/hr and maintenance.md Evanston $125 first hour, ordinary generalist visit assumption.
customer_action: Arrange access and review finding before considering replacement.

scope: Later drywall work after plumber traces leak and assembly is dry
assumptions: Affected area and finish unknown, future work only.
basis: maintenance.md patch bands require size/finish; no agreed price.
customer_action: Wait for release, measure and select finish.

scope: Replace rotted door trim and chipped sill, excluding concealed additional work
assumptions: Lengths, profiles and siding tie-in unknown.
basis: work-packages.md: stock/finish and exposure needed. Unknown rate for additional sheathing cannot be inferred.
customer_action: Measure trim and sill; approve photo, measured sheathing extent and separate written cost before extra work; stop for framing.

scope: Signed labor and reconciled hall-bath tile allowance
assumptions: No area, product, disclosed contractual amount or labor coverage.
basis: guide.md: preserve signed labor and allowance; do not fabricate financial terms.
customer_action: Retrieve contract and select tile; approve adjustment up or down before order.

scope: Move-in punch-list labor, billed as worked, up to three hours
assumptions: Ordinary scheduled visit; duration unknown; hourly basis, no minimum or three-hour charge assumed.
basis: inputs.md $60 Chicago task platform, maintenance.md $125/hr Evanston. Three-hour indicative maximum $180–375, actual contract governs.
customer_action: Prioritize knobs then drawer; approve before exceeding three hours.

scope: One shared first-hour visit for shelf and coat hook
assumptions: One standard wall, owner hardware; no added time booked.
basis: inputs.md one-hour $60 platform comparator; maintenance.md $125 scheduled first-hour minimum, one dispatch.
customer_action: Approve any additional time separately.

scope: Prep and paint one fence face incl materials
assumptions: Approx 100 ft; height, board pattern, surface condition, paint system unknown.
basis: outdoors.md covers fence construction, not coatings; inputs.md needs coat count/area before $/LF.
customer_action: Measure net length and agree specifications before extending rate.

scope: Unselected new screen door; preliminary scope
assumptions: No handing, size, model or price; ceiling is not a quote.
basis: maintenance.md San Diego screen offerings vary by type and do not identify the unit; no purchase approval.
customer_action: Select compatible unit and request supply/install quote within ceiling.

scope: Supply and install six closet shelves and a rail
assumptions: Dimensions, material, support and accepted contract terms unavailable.
basis: work-packages.md requires cut list and mounting details. Can't infer agreement/deposit.
customer_action: Use accepted total, deposit credit and balance as recorded.

scope: Alternatives: rescreen existing frame or supply/install complete new screen door
assumptions: No chosen option, door type unknown.
basis: maintenance.md San Diego example for standard slider $95 rescreen subject to $145 mobile minimum, $329 new slider. These options are separate and not a combined total.
customer_action: Confirm swing/slider and select one option.

scope: Supply and install 46 linear feet of baseboard including caulk
assumptions: Basic paint-grade trim, ordinary corners, no removals or painting.
basis: maintenance.md Tampa 5-in baseboard $4/ft supplied/installed ×46=$184. High judgment $9.78/ft for Chicago small-job setup/caulk/stock.
customer_action: Confirm profile, corners, local material and supplied rate. Owner paints.

scope: Tighten and test handle plus unpriced clog diagnosis
assumptions: Handle work can be bounded $60–125 for one generalist hour; diagnosis scope unsettled.
basis: inputs.md and maintenance.md per-visit hourly examples; guide.md requires incomplete scope remain partial.
customer_action: Approve diagnostic price first; no drain clearing commitment.

scope: Labor package replacing two towel bars and one paper holder on verified backing
assumptions: One shared appointment, owner supplies pieces; modeled 1.5–2 hours.
basis: inputs.md $60/hr Chicago ×1.5; maintenance.md $125/hr Evanston ×2. Time judgment. Single lump sum.
customer_action: Have all three pieces ready and confirm positions.

scope: Two visits for nail-pop repair, prime and repaint one guest-room wall
assumptions: Standard-size wall, modest repair count and ordinary paint; no expedited date assumed.
basis: maintenance.md WI $75 nail holes, $225 per wall, $125 paint repair areas; scopes overlap. Low/high judgment includes separate return and drying.
customer_action: Confirm wall size, paint supply, drying schedule, and actual return date.

scope: Hook up washer and electric dryer only, owner retains old machines
assumptions: Two simple plug/hose/vent hookups in prepared locations, ready accessories; one visit 2–2.5 worker-hours assumed.
basis: inputs.md $60/hr Chicago ×2 to maintenance.md $125/hr nearby ×2.5 rounded; no dishwasher or haul.
customer_action: Check washer hoses, dryer cord and duct; retailer handles dishwasher.

scope: Replace one matching fence panel from owner's side only
assumptions: Access unverified; panel width, material, retention and condition unknown.
basis: outdoors.md per-foot full replacement not a panel repair price; cannot price until access/stock confirmed.
customer_action: Measure clearance from owner's property; verify matching stock before acceptance.

scope: Assemble and anchor two bookshelves, flatten boxes at curb
assumptions: Ordinary flat packs and compatible wall anchor locations; 2–3 total labor hours; bookshelves supplied.
basis: inputs.md $60/hr Chicago ×2 to maintenance.md $125/hr Evanston ×3; duration judgment.
customer_action: Confirm models, anchoring locations and that packaging is accepted at curb.

scope: Later cabinet condition check after urgent plumber stops leak
assumptions: No inspection date, scope or price; leak active now.
basis: work-packages.md scope/handoff first; future check is explicitly unpriced.
customer_action: Use urgent plumber already arranged; schedule conditional cabinet assessment once released.

scope: Remove/rehang laundry door, swap washer, connect and test; owner takes old washer
assumptions: Door off hinges, existing compatible services, no frame work; estimate 2–3 worker-hours.
basis: inputs.md Chicago $60/hr ×2 to maintenance.md Evanston $125/hr ×3; duration judgment.
customer_action: Confirm fittings and door removal clears unit; arrange old washer handling.

scope: Coordinate garage-door specialist appointment only
assumptions: No charge or repair agreed; fault unknown.
basis: guide.md retains handoff; specialist costs cannot be attributed to handyman.
customer_action: Arrange specialist and confirm any charge independently.

scope: Labor for confirmed direct-fit bath-fan replacement
assumptions: Compatible owner-supplied replacement; 1.5–2 worker-hours assumed. Current unit does not fit.
basis: inputs.md Chicago $60/hr ×1.5 to maintenance.md Evanston $125/hr ×2; duration judgment, licensed trade rate may differ.
customer_action: Return incompatible fan and confirm direct-fit unit before booking. No resizing or added visit.

scope: Refinish stairs only; owner pays electrician directly
assumptions: Tread count, finish coverage and prep unknown; owner-direct electrical hours unknown.
basis: work-packages.md: need measured surfaces and coating system.
customer_action: Count treads/risers and confirm finish and access. Keep electrician separate.

scope: Stain fence with specified prep; patio wash is optional
assumptions: Area, fence construction, prior coating and coat count unknown; patio unelected.
basis: inputs.md: material quantity and labor need area and coat count. No separate trip.
customer_action: Verify fence dimensions; authorize patio separately in writing only if desired.
